sourceBoundary: The owner-authored three-selection Eternals list, expanded in selection and original-issue order: Eternals (1976) #1-11, Eternals (2006) #1-7, then Eternals (2021) #1-6. The edition ledger preserves the original wording, factual receipts and approved Gillen subtitle correction. No complete run, Annual, later volume or collection ID is substituted.
excludedSourceReferences: Eternals (1976) #12-19 and Eternals Annual (1977) #1 are outside Kirby Vol. 1.
Later Gillen volumes and one-shots are outside Only Death Is Eternal.
Unverified film-tone and adaptation comparisons are not shipped recommendation claims.

proposedManifest.name: Eternals
proposedManifest.description: Three owner-selected Eternals collections: Jack Kirby's first volume, Neil Gaiman and John Romita Jr.'s miniseries, then Kieron Gillen and Esad Ribic's first volume. Original issues only.

sourceReview.rationale: The owner expressly approved the bounded 24-original vector and retained Eternals (2021) #1-6 in both this list and the existing Thanos guide. This approval was relayed by the MCU Prep coordinator and does not authorize changed candidate vectors or new relationships.
